svg.title: Paper-EaTER-PANnel: application data flow including review
svg.desc: Eight phases run left to right. Within each phase, steps run downward. Original PDF and scoped configuration pass through CLI and external model services to separate structured candidates, comparison, human review, approved application, and local reading or manual handoff. Storage and lifecycle controls are shown below. Open decisions are explicitly marked.
svg.text: First-version documentation path, review included · Conceptual design, not a verified implementation or approved state machine

g.text: Local storage chosen by the user
One paper context per processor call
Web retrieval is a later possibility
Necessary source input may be sent
Local app does not mean local model
Detailed future flows not yet designed

svg.text: USER-APPROVED RERUN → scope / count / CLI / model → fresh candidates; keep current and previous results
No suitable candidate? Rerun during review. Optional review chat may suggest changes; conversation alone does not Apply.
LOCAL WORKSPACE · source / runs / current / review · metadata schema and write transactions remain to be specified

g.text: Original PDF / input identity / source evidence
Read for model input, comparison and human review
provenance.json + result/ · per-call structured candidates and assets
Persist candidate history; manual deletion only; never overwrite current during review
Selected changes, approval decisions, application outcomes; precise fields open
Markdown sections + document.json + bibliography.json + citation.bib + assets
Current content changes through approved Apply; original bibliographic notation preserved

svg.text: Processing, review and Apply have distinct completion states.
All must complete for final completion; override status remains open.
Apply is blocked during active review; other papers may continue.
User chooses: continue in background / force termination / prepare then exit.
Explain that closing the interface may leave processing running.
Defaults, saved selections, lock restoration and recovery guarantees are open.
Show complete override process with concise explanation + diagram.
Keep explicit user choices; disclose fallback result and selection basis.
Missing calls, query-1 failure and mandatory-figure exceptions are open.
READING GUIDE: solid arrows = conceptual data flow; amber dashed arrow = rerun control; dotted arrows = storage association. Phase order does not settle scheduling or atomicity.
Design review artifact · Broad direction → right; within phases ↓ down · Requirements trace to docs/design-status.md and docs/open-design.md · No application implementation
